summary: Halozyme Therapeutics filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026, announcing a proposed private offering of $1.05 billion aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2033, with a 13-day option for initial purchasers to buy up to an additional $150 million. The notes are senior, unsecured obligations, offered only to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A, maturing October 1, 2033, with semi-annual interest. Terms including coupon, conversion premium and price are unstated. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch pricing, concurrent capped-call or note-hedge activity, and equity overhang.
